# Nvidias milliardfest og Trumps tech-topmøde

**Feed**: store-penge  
**Published**: 2026-10-01  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This Danish Store Penge episode centres on Nvidia's record $150bn buyback, which the hosts read as management saying the stock is undervalued. The P/E has fallen from about 53 to 29 while revenue doubled. They also cover the reported OpenAI and Anthropic revenue run-rates, whether AI capex is building a debt bomb (they mostly think it is not), and Trump's AI-boss summit. A second theme is Russia's escalating hybrid war against Europe, which guest Tobias and host Mikkel see as a driver for drone, sensor and defence stocks such as Saab, Parrot and Hensoldt. Overall the market view is constructive, with interest-rate and debt risk flagged.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟡 NVDA — Nvidia | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 75%

Tobias holds Nvidia as >7% of his private portfolio and will keep it; sees it as fully priced short-term but trusts it long-term.

#### Reasoning

Guest Tobias: the buyback signals undervaluation, the P/E has compressed from 53 to 29 while revenue doubled, and existing customers' AI infrastructure demand is up 100%. Short-term the stock is efficiently priced. Physical AI could keep Nvidia relevant. Host Mikkel adds a risk: if compute shifts from training to inference, cheaper alternatives could pressure growth.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI labs shift compute from training to inference toward cheaper alternatives
- if OpenAI/Anthropic revenue figures prove false at IPO
- if interest rates rise substantially, straining debt-financed AI capex

> *"På den længere bane, så har jeg meget tiltro til Nvidia, og det er stadigvæk i min private portefølje, en af mine største positioner"*

---

### 🟢 SAAB-B — Saab | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Tobias is positive on Saab given its autonomous/unmanned defence tech as Russian hybrid war escalates.

#### Reasoning

Guest Tobias expects the Russia-Europe hybrid conflict to escalate over the coming 2-3 quarters, pushing Europe to buy drone defence. Saab is named among three European defence companies he is positive on, because of its focus on unmanned systems.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Russia-Europe hybrid tensions de-escalate
- if European defence spending slows

> *"tre af de europæiske forsvarsvirksomheder, som jeg er ret positiv omkring her lige nu, det er bl.a. Svenske Saab"*

---

### 🟢 PARRO — Parrot | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Tobias owns a small position in this European drone pure play, which has deals with NATO and Australia.

#### Reasoning

Guest Tobias: one of the few pure-play drone stocks in Europe. Europe needs European producers, and he expects Parrot to gain market share. It already has solid contracts with NATO and Australia.

#### Sell Triggers

- if drone contract wins stall
- if hybrid-war threat recedes

> *"den franske virksomhed, der hedder Parrot. Parrot arbejder med drone-teknologi, og det er et af de her få pure play drone-aktier"*

---

### 🟢 HAG — Hensoldt | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 75%

Tobias is considering buying; Mikkel has bought it and calls it the closest pure play on the counter-hybrid-war theme.

#### Reasoning

Hensoldt's sensors and radar suit defence against sabotage and drone hybrid attacks, unlike ammunition makers such as Rheinmetall. Both the guest (considering a purchase) and the host (already bought) back it.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Russian hybrid escalation fades
- if European sensor/radar procurement disappoints

> *"Jeg har selv købt hensoldt, det var det, jeg selv ville nævne."*

---

### 🟠 LMT — Lockheed Martin | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Tobias is watching it as the largest defence exporter to Europe, with a solid US base.

#### Reasoning

Guest Tobias names Lockheed among the cases he is watching: it gives indirect exposure to European rearmament while being anchored in the US market.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Europe shifts procurement to European suppliers

> *"en anden aktie, som jeg synes er også relevant inden for den her sektor, det er Lockheed Martin"*

---

### 🟢 MRVL — Marvell | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Mikkel likes Marvell's inference-rack silicon; it could win if compute shifts to inference and is a winner stock regardless.

#### Reasoning

Host Mikkel expects AI compute to shift from frontier training to inference. Marvell supplies silicon for inference racks and would benefit. He expresses fairly high conviction that it is a winner either way.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the shift from training to inference does not materialise
- if AI capex slows on debt or rate pressure

> *"uanset hvad skal det nok være en vinderaktie af ret stor tiltro til"*

---

### 🟠 MU — Micron | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Mikkel lists it among summit attendees still expected to deliver fine growth rates.

#### Reasoning

Host Mikkel argues that most summit attendees are mature, but some, such as Micron, still have growth. It is only a passing mention. He also notes that memory prices would fall first if AI demand disappoints.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI demand falters and memory/RAM prices drop

> *"Micron og andre, der også skal have fine vækstrater"*

---
